name: rift-companion
description: Companion app para League of Legends: conexão com o cliente, builds e histórico.

scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron
scripts.dev: npm run build:electron && concurrently -k -n ng,electron "npm --prefix renderer start" "wait-on http://localhost:4200 && cross-env RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:4200 electron ."
